build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places two dynamic balls and static bars in a scene
add_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball body with configurable scale, center_x, and bottom position
add_static_bar: create a static bar body with configurable scale, angle, and position in the scene
update_task_relationships: update the task to require two bodies to be in a TOUCHING spatial relationship
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to the TWO_BALLS solution tier for categorization
